s: Venerable Ascetic Mahâvîra has embryo of the Venerable Ascetic Mahâvîra (in Trisalâ's womb)
q: the embryo of the Venerable Ascetic Mahâvîra

s: Brâhmanî Devânandâ has the womb of Devânandâ
q: the embryo of the Venerable Ascetic Mahâvîra was removed from the womb of the Brâhmanî Devânandâ of the Gâlandharâyana gotra

s: Kshatriyânî Trisalâ has the fourteen great dreams (in the night of the embryo's removal)
q: the latter was in her dwelling-place, of which the interior was ornamented with pictures, and the outside whitewashed, furbished and cleansed, the brilliant surface of the ceiling was painted, the darkness was dispelled by jewels and precious stones, the floor was perfectly level and adorned with auspicious figures; which, moreover, was furnished with offerings of heaps of delicious, fragrant, strewn flowers of all five colours, was highly delightful through curling, scented fumes of black aloe, the finest Kundurukka and Turushka, and burning frankincense; was exquisitely scented with fine perfumes, and turned as it were into a smelling-bottle; on a couch with a mattress of a man's length, with pillows at head and foot, raised on both sides and hollow in the middle, soft as if one walked on the sand of the banks of the Ganges, covered with the cloth of a robe of ornamented linen, containing a well-worked towel, and hung with red mosquito curtains, delightful, soft to the touch like fur, wadding, Pûra, butter, or cotton, with all the comforts of a bed, such as fragrant, excellent flowers and sandal-powder--(in such a room and on such a bed Trisalâ was) taking fits of sleep between sleeping and waking, and having seen the following fourteen, &c. (see § 3), dreams, viz. an elephant, &c. (see § 4), she awoke.

s: the fourteen great dreams is a fourteen auspicious dreams (seen by Kshatriyânî Trisalâ)
q: these fourteen illustrious, beautiful, lucky, blest, auspicious, fortunate, great dreams

s: Kshatriyânî Trisalâ is wife of Siddhârtha
q: Then the Kshatriya Siddhârtha placed his wife Trisalâ behind the curtain

q: From that moment in which the Venerable Ascetic Mahâvîra was brought into the family of the Gñâtris

q: From the moment that this our boy has been begotten, our silver increased, our gold increased, &c.

s: Sakra commands many demons in Vaisramana's service (to the palace of king Siddhârtha)
q: many demons in Vaisramana's service, belonging to the animal world, brought, on Sakra's command, to the palace of king Siddhârtha

s: mothers of universal monarchs or of Arhats see the fourteen great dreams (when the embryo of a universal monarch or an Arhat enters their womb)
q: the mothers of universal monarchs or of Arhats wake up after seeing these fourteen great dreams out of the thirty great dreams, when the embryo of a universal monarch or an Arhat enters their womb

s: family servants of Kshatriya Siddhârtha serve Siddhârtha (as household attendants)
q: When the family servants were thus spoken to by king Siddhârtha

q: call the interpreters of dreams who well know the science of prognostics with its eight branches, and are well versed in many sciences besides!

s: interpreters of dreams know science of prognostics (including its eight branches)
q: the interpreters of dreams who well know the science of prognostics with its eight branches

q: in our dream-books are enumerated forty-two (common) dreams and thirty great dreams.

q: in our dream-books are enumerated forty-two (common) dreams and thirty great dreams.

q: after the lapse of nine months and seven and a half days, in the first month of summer, in the second fortnight, the dark (fortnight) of Kaitra, on its fourteenth day

q: in the second fortnight, the dark (fortnight) of Kaitra, on its fourteenth day

s: first month of summer contains birth of Mahâvîra (after nine months and seven and a half days)

q: Now the Venerable Ascetic Mahâvîra, out of compassion for his mother, did not move nor stir nor quiver, but remained quiet, stiff, and motionless.

s: Siddhârtha has name Sreyâmsa (one of three names)

q: reached the highest knowledge and intuition, called Kevala, which is infinite, supreme, unobstructed, unimpeded, complete, and full.

s: Kevala is a highest knowledge and intuition (infinite, supreme, unobstructed, unimpeded, complete, and full)
q: reached the highest knowledge and intuition, called Kevala, which is infinite, supreme, unobstructed, unimpeded, complete, and full.

s: Venerable Ascetic Mahâvîra is a Gina (after attaining Kevala)
q: When the Venerable Ascetic Mahâvîra had become a Gina and Arhat

q: his oldest disciple, the monk Indrabhûti of the Gautama gotra

q: an excellent community of fourteen thousand Sramanas with Indrabhûti at their head

(see § 91, down to) Vardhamâna. Now our wishes have been fulfilled, therefore shall the name of our boy be Vardhamâna."'

s: Venerable Ascetic Mahâvîra has name Sramana (because he is devoid of love and hate)
q: because he is devoid of love and hate, he is called Sramana (i.e. Ascetic)

s: Venerable Ascetic Mahâvîra belongs to gotra Kâsyapa gotra
q: The Venerable Ascetic Mahâvîra belonged to the Kâsyapa gotra.

s: Vardhamâna is a Gñâtri Kshatriya (son of a Gñâtri Kshatriya)
q: The Venerable Ascetic Mahâvîra--clever, with the aspirations of a clever man, of great beauty, controlling (his senses), lucky, and modest; a Gñâtri Kshatriya, the son of a Gñâtri Kshatriya;

s: Vardhamâna is a prince of Videha (a Videha and son of Videhadattâ)
q: a Videha, the son of Videhadattâ, a native of Videha, a prince of Videha--

q: Since the time that the Venerable Ascetic Mahâvira died, &c.

q: Since the time that the Venerable Ascetic Mahâvira died, &c. (all down to) freed from all pains, nine centuries have elapsed

q: Another redaction has ninety-third year (instead of eightieth).

q: End of the Fifth Lecture.

q: End of the Life of Mahâvîra.

s: Nirvâna of Mahâvira freed from pains
q: Since the time that the Venerable Ascetic Mahâvira died, &c. (all down to) freed from all pains, nine centuries have elapsed

q: riding in his palankin called Visâlâ

q: in Visâkhâ he obtained final liberation

q: Life of Arishtanemi.
